methodology.pair_rule: favor the currency with the higher layer signal; ties skipped
methodology.macro: retrospective diagnostic using the runtime Growth + Labour normalization logic; not full PIT because release-date/vintage history is incomplete
methodology.rates: market-history point-in-time; EUR excluded because historical 2Y basis is withheld
methodology.cot: weekly net-position flow; signal activation delayed by 3 calendar days to respect CFTC publication timing
methodology.liquidity: retrospective diagnostic using the primary liquidity series; NZD excluded
methodology.combined: Macro + Rates only when both currency-level directions are aligned; EUR excluded

interpretation: Macro has a positive retrospective relationship at 4W/12W, but the edge weakens materially in 2023-2026 and cannot be treated as validated PIT alpha.
Rates direction by itself shows no stable continuation edge in the available same-basis history.
COT weekly flow does not support continuation at 1W/4W; this supports keeping COT as positioning/context rather than a core directional engine.
Liquidity is weak as a direct directional signal and loses effectiveness in the recent sample; keep it as overlay.
Macro + Rates alignment is the most encouraging recent combination at 4W, but the sample is only 10 checkpoints and is not sufficient for a validated claim.
model_implications: Do not promote Rates-alone, COT-flow or Liquidity-alone to structural drivers.
Keep Macro as a core pillar but do not treat its historical relationship as a standalone trading signal.
Keep COT and Liquidity as overlays/context, consistent with the current architecture.
Continue the clean forward OOS for the full canonical engine before any further rule promotion or threshold change.
